content.title: Teekay Tankers: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HAMILTON, Bermuda (AP) — Teekay Tankers Ltd. (TNK) on Wednesday reported earnings of $92.1 million in its third quarter. On a per-share basis, the Hamilton, Bermuda-based company said it had net income of $2.64. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring gains, came to $1.54 per share.
